messages.name: invite_default
messages.rendered_html:
Gumroad team invitation

You have been invited to join a team on Gumroad with the role of Admin.

This is a team invitation, not a purchase receipt or a charge notice.

This invitation will expire in 7 days.

If you are not expecting an invitation, please ignore this email.

Accept invitation

Button not working?

If this invitation expires, ask the account owner to send a new invitation.

548 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94104-5401, USA

Powered by
